jobs.occupation: Junior Technology Analyst (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Junior Technology Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Technology Manager by gathering, structuring, and maintaining technology scouting intelligence across emerging technologies, startups, research developments, market signals, and innovation ecosystems relevant to Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve monitoring technology domains, conducting desk research, and preparing technology opportunity profiles. You will play a key role in ensuring that external signals are captured consistently and translated into clear inputs for further assessment, contributing to the PRM Technology Radar and other analytical activities.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitor selected technology domains, startups, research institutions, publications, and market developments relevant to Grid Technologies
* Capture early technology signals and maintain structured scouting inputs across H1–H4 horizons
* Maintain and update Technology Radar entries, ensuring consistent documentation of technology signals and assessment status
* Support preparation for interactions with startups, universities, and research institutes, including background notes and technology summaries
* Maintain scouting records and briefing materials in the central repository, preparing concise summaries and visual inputs for technology briefings
* Use digital and AI-enabled tools to improve searchability, synthesis, and reuse of technology intelligence

What You Bring

* Relevant bachelor’s degree or diploma in engineering, technology management, business, innovation management, data analytics, or a related field
* First experiences in technology scouting, research, strategy, innovation, R&D, consulting, or market intelligence
* Very good understanding of research and the technology of Siemens Energy, with a willingness to learn more
* Curiosity for emerging technologies, energy systems, grid technologies, startups, and innovation ecosystems
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure information and summarize complex topics clearly
* Fluent in English, with good communication skills and attention to detail

jobs.occupation: Technology Scouting & Innovation Manager (f/m/d) (Wirtschaftsingenieur/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As the Technology Scouting & Innovation Manager (f/m/d), you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Grid Technologies. Your typical day will involve systematically identifying emerging technologies, monitoring market disruptions, and analyzing startup activities. You will serve as the organization’s “early warning and opportunity detection system,” translating external technology signals into actionable insights that inform strategy, portfolio steering, and investment decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and maintain a structured technology scouting process across H1–H4 horizons
* Identify emerging technologies with potential impact on Grid Technologies
* Own and continuously update the PRM Technology Radar and create strategic heatmaps of technology opportunities and threats
* Maintain visibility of startup, university, and research ecosystems to support partnership and investment opportunities
* Establish and maintain a central technology knowledge repository to ensure effective dissemination of insights
* Produce actionable intelligence reports for leadership teams and convert technology signals into portfolio recommendations

What You Bring

* Relevant and applicable bachelor’s degree/diploma
* Long-term experience in technology development and Ventures/M&A type projects
* Strong technical focus with a solid understanding of what Siemens Energy does, though not necessarily an expert in specific technologies
* Experience in innovation projects involving universities, research facilities, or similar environments
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills in global matrix organizations, with the ability to translate external signals into clear portfolio and roadmap insights
* Fluent in English

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for Imaging and Spatial Omics Data (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is looking, starting from December 2026, for a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for Imaging and Spatial Omics Data.

The core facilities, Single-Cell Open Lab and the Omics IT and Data Management Core Facility (ODCF) at the DKFZ, provide infrastructure and workflows for single-cell and spatial omics projects. To strengthen our teams from September 2026, we are seeking a Research Software Engineer / Software Developer for imaging and spatial omics data within the ID3:bio 2.0 project (https://gerbi-gmb.de/i3dbio/).
ID3:bio 2.0 is a DFG-funded project that aims to deliver tools and strategies for the FAIR management of imaging and spatial omics data. Together with the universities of Düsseldorf and Tübingen, we develop and implement standards for metadata, file formats, data-exchange strategies, and long-term archiving.

Your Tasks

You will work in an interdisciplinary team of software developers, bioinformaticians, system administrators, and wet lab scientists, with software development at the center of your role:

- Develop and extend our GUIDE metadata platform (a Kotlin-based application) to annotate generic (meta)data and to import non-sequencing data types into the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and build the integration of the OMERO imaging platform with genomic data (OTP) within the ODCF infrastructure
- Design and implement user and permission management across the imaging and genomics systems
- Implement metadata schemas and packaging formats such as RO-Crate for spatial data
- Build tools to collect, organize, and validate research (meta)data
- Co-organize and take part in hackathons
- Organize workshops and train users to work in line with the FAIR principles

Your Profile

If you enjoy building software in an interdisciplinary team and want to enable exciting research by easing data flow for more robust and excellent analysis, this position is for you.

- Master's degree (or equivalent qualification and relevant professional experience) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
- Substantial software development experience, including professional proficiency in Kotlin (our GUIDE platform is Kotlin-based) or Java
- Proficiency in at least one further language such as Python or JavaScript
- Experience with system administration, container and cloud technologies, and Linux
- Genuine interest in the biological and life-science background of the data — curiosity is essential, but no prior training in biology is required
- Ability to solve complex problems in a structured, well-documented way together with internal and external partners
- Willingness to explain complex technical workflows to non-specialists
- Very good command of English

Advantageous

- Experience in research data management (omics and/or imaging data)
- Experience with OMERO and imaging data
- Experience with ontologies, RO-Crate, and the SpatialData framework
- Experience in open-source software engineering and HPC
- Experience in organizing hackathons and community engagement

How to apply:

Please provide a motivation letter, CV, and highest education certificate. The motivation letter should clearly state your contribution to the project in reference to the expected skills. Please also state your own key interests and expectations for your role in the project.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Dr. Jan-Philipp Mallm
Phone: +49 (0)6221/54-51378

​Duration: The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: September 30, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. Job description

System Safety Engineer (d/f/m)

to support the Aircraft Development Safety Manching team. You will ensure that Airbus products are developed, designed, produced and supported according to the state-of-art and the relevant safety standards (associated to airworthiness regulations). Safety of the vehicle is maintained throughout its whole lifecycle, considering Human Factors and operation.

You are interested in assessing complex functions through Aircrafts and Systems, analyse the propagation of mechanical or electrical/electronical malfunctions and unintended human operation throughout the system with regards to hazardous Aircraft reaction.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments

- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead and conduct main Safety assessments (Functional Hazard Assessment/System Safety Assessment) activities for military aircraft and systems, supporting the phases until certification
- Lead and conduct Risk Analyses, according to the applicable guidance and standards, which are required to support the continuous aircraft development (including Permit to Fly/Type Certificate)
- Lead and conduct Common-Cause Analyses (Particular Risk Analysis, Zonal Safety Analysis and Common Mode Analysis)
- Lead, manage and generate safety requirements, safety evidences (tests, simulation, analyses), Safety Procedures and Limitations, interface with other technical domains (processes, maintenance, human factors, aircraft performance and quality, etc.)

- Minimum 3 years working experience in related engineering field
- Knowledge/understanding of Aircraft systems
- System Safety Assessment experience would be an advantage, at least System Engineering experience with interface to Safety Assessment/Airworthiness/Certification
- advanced skills with MS Office are presumed
- Good communication skills and strong problem-solving capability are desirable
- Experience with Safety Tools (e.g. Isograph FaultTree+, Reliability Workbench)
- Very good English language skills, German language is desirable

This position will require a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student for the Hector-Center, Medical Clinic 1, (m/f/d) (Assistent/in - klinische Studien)
jobs.description:
The Hector-Center for Nutrition, Exercise and Sports, Medical Clinic 1, conducts clinical and experimental research in the fields of cancer, obesity, food intolerances, and microbiota. Our translational research projects aim to better understand disease mechanisms and ultimately improve patient care and therapeutic strategies.
A major focus of our research is cancer cachexia, a complex metabolic syndrome that significantly contributes to loss of skeletal muscle and adipose tissue, impaired physical function, reduced quality of life, and poor clinical outcomes in patients with cancer.
Within this research area, we investigate the interactions between cancer cells, skeletal muscle, adipose tissue, and immune cells, with a particular focus on the molecular and immunological mechanisms underlying cancer-associated tissue wasting.

Die Aufgaben

To strengthen our research team, we are looking for an excellent and highly motivated PhD student with a strong interest in cancer biology, metabolism, immunology, and/or molecular medicine.
Depending on the specific research focus, the work will involve:

- in vitro studies with cancer and muscle cells as well as immune cell models and analysis of tissue samples
- contribution to in vivo studies with mice
- preparation of scientific manuscripts and the PhD thesis

Das Know-how dafür

- Master’s degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Medicine, Biotechnology, or a related field
- solid knowledge of cellular and molecular biology
- practical experience with cell culture and molecular biology techniques
- ability to work independently, systematically, and reliably
- strong scientific curiosity and willingness to develop new experimental approaches
- ability to analyze and critically interpret scientific data
- excellent communication and teamwork skills
- good written and spoken English

Zusätzlich von Vorteil

- experience with cancer, skeletal muscle, adipocyte, or immune cell models
- experience with molecular biology techniques such as qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, or flow cytometry
- FELASA B certificate is advantageous but not mandatory

We are looking for a motivated scientist who is enthusiastic about understanding the mechanisms of cancer-associated wasting and developing new approaches to preserve tissue function and improve outcomes in patients with cancer.

Das bieten wir:

- salary according to E13 TV-L, 65%
- the position is intended to lead to a PhD
- an interdisciplinary and collaborative research environment
- access to modern laboratory infrastructure and established experimental models
- opportunities for scientific training, conference participation, and publication
- close supervision and support throughout the PhD project

- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Brand Management)
jobs.description:
Nature offers increasing opportunities. Grow with us. Bionorica, with
approximately 2200 employees worldwide, is the German market leader
for pharmacy-only herbal medicines. For over 90 years, we have been
unlocking the secrets of nature by combining the knowledge of
traditional medicinal plant therapy with the forward-looking results
of scientific research. "Phytoneering” is the formula of our success
with which we have been on a growth course for years. In this way, we
open up new markets with innovative, highly effective herbal
medicines. For our location in Neumarkt (Oberpfalz), we are looking
for a: (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead (m/f/d) To strengthen
our Global Brand Management team, we are looking for a creative and
strategic (Senior) Global Brand Manager / Team Lead – Franchise Head
(m/f/d) who will take responsibility for our respiratory (Sinupret) or
women´s health (Canephron) products. These are the tasks for this
position: Development of a mid-term vision, ambition, and strategy for
our brands in the respiratory (Sinupret) or women´s health
(Canephron) products sector, taking into account country-specific
market conditions and cultural differences Design and maintenance of
brand identity, ensuring brand consistency across all channels
Responsibility for the entire brand experience throughout the product
lifecycle Conducting analysis of campaign results and consumer
insights for continuous improvement Management and maintenance of
global brand books to ensure a consistent brand presence Conducting
market and consumer research to derive actionable insights Leading the
product portfolio and lifecycle management (LCM) to maximize market
success Planning and monitoring brand budgets to ensure financial
efficiency Sharing, reusing, and leading the global brand community to
promote best practices Developing and implementing strategies to
increase brand awareness and attractiveness Creating core creative
ideas and campaigns to support our global brand strategy Defining
compelling brand stories based on deep consumer insights Close
collaboration with relevant country colleagues Depending on
experience, qualifications and organizational needs, the role may
include team leadership responsibility, contributing to the
development of franchise priorities, capability building, and the
successful delivery of business objectives These are the requirements
you should meet: Completed studies in marketing, business
administration, or similar experience Several years of experience in
brand management, ideally in the pharmaceutical or herbal sector
Proven track record in developing and implementing brand strategies
and campaigns Strong analytical skills and experience in conducting
market research Creativity combined with a strategic approach Ideally
first experiences with the "How Brands Grow" approach on
evidence-based marketing Ability to work in a dynamic international
environment and lead cross-functional teams (optional: previous
experience leading a team) Proficiency in English (both written and
spoken), basic German knowledge would be an advantage We offer you: A
globally operating, family-owned company with a commitment to social
responsibility Flexible working hours and home office options to
support the balance between work and personal life Responsible fields
of activity with a thorough onboarding process and performance-based
compensation with attractive social benefits and company pension
scheme Exciting prospects in a globally growing company with a wide
range of professional and personal development opportunities
Compensation – Global Brand Manager: Compensation is governed by the
company's collective bargaining agreement, which is aligned with the
German Chemical Industry Collective Pay Agreement (BETV Chemie). The
anticipated salary grades are: Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 10/6
K to E 12/6 K, depending on qualifications and professional experience
Senior Global Brand Manager: pay grade E 13 K The monthly gross salary
for a full-time position (39.5 hours / week) ranges from approximately
5.422 € (E 10/6 K) to 6.819 € (E 13 K), depending on the
applicable pay grade. In addition, employees may be eligible for an
above-tariff allowance, a performance-related bonus linked to target
achievement, and further benefits in accordance with company policies.
Compensation – Team Lead: This position is compensated outside the
scope of the collective bargaining agreement. The starting salary is
determined based on a current market benchmark and the candidate's
profile and is expected to range between 96.000 € and 105.000 €
gross salary per annum, depending on qualifications and experience. In
addition, employees are eligible for a performance-related bonus
linked to target achievement, as well as benefits in accordance with
company policies. Contact: Are you open to new opportunities? Then
take your chance. Please apply through our online application form. We
look forward to meeting you! Join us! Contact person Bionorica SE
People & Organisation Theresa Frank www.bionorica.de

GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

You will lead Commissioning activities with an international team of Commissioning Engineers through different projects stages, starting from Commissioning Preparation through to on- site execution.

As a

The position requires international travels with construction site presence during the execution phase. The HVDC sites are located in Germany and Netherlands as well as in Singapore and Batam for the platform construction.

Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.

Maintain effective communication related to Commissioning scope with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders and be the main point of contact
Collaborate with the Project Team about Quality, Claim & Risk Management

You will actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
You will support our Commissioning Department with your expertise and will develop yourself with the state-of-the-art technologies

Knowledge and several years of experience in Commissioning of substations, Power Plants or HVDC Systems.
Excellent Communication skills paired with strong Leadership skills in an internation project environment
